review:
Elemental Hold the Jackpot on a 25-reel grid where reels unlock as you play. Guardian symbols on the middle row stick and switch on extra reels, so the grid grows during a session.

Cash Infinity symbols lock in until the bonus ends. A Cash Out timer turns Mystery Cash into instant payouts, and Chance Level multiplies the stake by up to 10x. 2,500x Grand, high volatility, 96.15% RTP. Good if you like progression over line wins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
